name: Keyword_Research_Automation_Using_Uipath_StudioX
headline: Keyword Research Automation: SEO Bot
short_description: a bot that automates keyword research for SEO purposes. The bot can search for relevant keywords using Google's Keyword Planner or other keyword research tools, and compile a list of high-ranking and relevant keywords for the website or content.
author: DhalavaiN

sections.overview:
This skill automates keyword research workflows using UiPath StudioX, enabling marketers and SEO professionals to identify high-ranking keywords efficiently. The bot integrates with Google Keyword Planner and other keyword research tools to search for relevant terms and compile comprehensive keyword lists. It eliminates manual research by systematically gathering data on keyword performance and relevance. The resulting keyword compilations support content strategy, on-page optimization, and competitive analysis. Teams can deploy this automation to accelerate SEO planning cycles and identify untapped keyword opportunities.
Content planning: Identify target keywords before creating blog posts or web pages
SEO strategy: Build keyword lists for competitor analysis and niche research
PPC campaign prep: Research high-intent keywords for ad targeting
On-page optimization: Find relevant keywords for existing page improvements
